title: ContentItem
description: A single planned content unit from content-plan; carried through research → studio → review (spec §7.2-§7.4, §12).

journey_stage.description: Where the reader is. Engine-fixed vocabulary; which stages a profile works, and in what mix, is tenant config in knowledge/content-priority.md. Optional — items planned before this axis existed simply omit it.

goal.description: What this item optimizes for — deliberately NOT the same axis as journey_stage (a conversion-stage item may still be planned for reach). The per-week quota lives in knowledge/content-priority.md. Optional.

hook_id.description: Stable id from the hook BANK, knowledge/hooks.toml, which owns the hook_id namespace — NOT hook-matrix.md, which holds 1:1 outreach openers and in some tenants has no id column at all. Used as the attribution key in outcomes.jsonl (tag hook:<id>). Optional — assigned at Gate 1 when the item matches a bank hook whose formats declare this item's format, omitted otherwise.

locale.description: BCP-47-ish locale tag; primary if omitted.

brief.description: Pre-generation steering written at Gate 1. Consumed by content-studio.

angle.description: The specific take or argument for this piece.

hook_direction.description: How to open (stat-first, failure-story, question, etc.).

tone.description: Voice/style note, e.g. 'strategic informality, peer not vendor'.

avoid.description: Phrases, claims, or framings to exclude.

audience.description: Who this piece is for — a segment name from icp-personas.md or a short free-form description. Optional; operator-steerable at Gate 1.

trigger_stack.description: Named psychological triggers this item leans on (see virality-engineering.md), e.g. 'T5 curiosity gap + T4 productive discomfort'. Optional; operator-steerable at Gate 1.

core_value.description: The human value this piece is about, in one word (innovation -> perseverance). Derived from the pillar at Gate 1; what the script's story-washing check holds the payoff to. Optional; operator-steerable at Gate 1.

opposite.description: That value's opposite (perseverance -> giving up), taken from the persona's believed-but-never-said line in audience-psychology.md. Optional; operator-steerable at Gate 1.

protagonist.description: Who the journey from opposite to core_value costs most — someone expected to embody the value and privately living its opposite. Its presence marks the item as story-format downstream. Optional; operator-steerable at Gate 1.
